title: Mannina Doni
desc: Karthik falls in love with Sowbhagya on his visit to her village. After marriage, they head to Mysuru, where a mystery connected to her unfolds.

title: Mungaru Male
desc: Preetham loves Nandhini but gets heartbroken when he comes to know that her marriage is already fixed. Things change when she challenges him to win her heart.

title: Mungaru Male 2
desc: Preetham, the son of Suryakanth, a millionaire, is driven by excitement and easily gets bored when it comes to relationships. He understands love after he meets Nandini.

title: Gowramma
desc: Venky, a boy from a small town, comes to the city in pursuit of education. His father wants him to do a productive job and sends him to the city to get a job at a friend's place.

title: Gajanana & Gang
desc: Gaja, a young man known for his calm demeanour, is forced to join hands with his college friends and rebel against his seniors after they display unruly behaviour.

title: Kiragoorina Gayyaligalu
desc: A village living in harmony faces challenges when politicians try to divide the people based on caste. Subsequently, female villagers take up the task of fighting the oppressors.

desc: Chanchala, an IAS officer, is imprisoned in a haunted house for interrogation. However, things take an unexpected turn when she gets possessed by a spirit.
